Tavvik.narrative: I am Tavvik, a hunter of Highshelf. The elder forbade trade with Kettlebridge after the cairn was cut, but I still carry meat down the giants' track and bring timber back up. The shelf needs timber, and the meat will spoil if I do not. I owe no apology for that. Ezra Holt owes me for meat, and I mean to collect.
goals: keep the timber coming up the track
collect what Ezra Holt owes me
keep my courtship of Prudence Vane hidden

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: elder
relations.note: She forbade the trade, but the shelf needs timber. I disobey her, and I know it.

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: elder's son
relations.note: He wants Ezra Holt to answer for the cairn. I want my timber and my debt paid.

relations.name: Harl
relations.label: brother
relations.note: He hunts beside me and worries about my trade. I trust him, even if he does not approve.

relations.name: Sunniva
relations.label: sister-in-law
relations.note: She thinks my defiance will bring trouble. She may be right, but I will not stop.

relations.name: Grimhild
relations.label: niece
relations.note: She is afraid of the wolves. I would keep them from her.

relations.name: Ezra Holt
relations.label: debtor
relations.note: He owes me for meat. He cut the cairn, and now the shelf is closed. I still want my payment.

relations.name: Prudence Vane
relations.label: sweetheart
relations.note: A Kettlebridge cook who buys my meat. No one on the shelf knows, and it must stay that way.

relations.name: Gaudra
relations.label: neighbour
relations.note: She worries about the winter store. I bring meat, but she wants more.

relations.name: Steinar
relations.label: builder
relations.note: He keeps the cairns in repair and says little to me about the track; I respect his silence.

memories.gist: The elder forbade trade with Kettlebridge after the cairn cutting. I heard her word and chose to keep carrying meat down the track.
Ezra Holt took meat from me and promised to pay. He has not paid yet.
Prudence Vane bought meat from me and smiled. I have kept going back to her stall ever since.
Harl and I hunted a stag in the high pastures and carried it back for the store.
Sunniva argued that the meat store would last the winter and the shelf should not trade. I said nothing, but I disagreed.

stances.why: The shelf needs timber, and the meat will spoil. The ban hurts us more than it hurts Kettlebridge.
Ezra Holt owes me for meat. A debt is a debt, even if he cut the cairn.
Hollbrenna would see it as another defiance. Prudence is worth the risk, but I will not flaunt it.
Harl and Grimhild are my blood. I would do anything for them, even if we disagree.

Tavvik.secret: I am sweet on Prudence Vane, a Kettlebridge cook who buys my meat. No one on the shelf knows.

Harl.narrative: I am Harl, huntsman of Highshelf. I keep the shelf's meat store with my brother Tavvik, and my wife Sunniva smokes and dries what we bring in. I am loyal to the elder, but Tavvik is my brother, and I cannot turn my back on him. The winter store is my worry, and I count the barrels more often than I say.
goals: keep the meat store full for winter
keep peace between Tavvik and the elder

relations.name: Tavvik
relations.label: brother
relations.note: He defies the elder, and I fear it will bring trouble. But he is my brother, and I hunt beside him.

relations.name: Sunniva
relations.label: wife
relations.note: She keeps the meat store and the common table. She thinks Tavvik's trade will bring trouble, and I cannot say she is wrong.

relations.name: Grimhild
relations.label: daughter
relations.note: She is afraid of the wolves. I would keep her safe from them and from everything else.

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: elder
relations.note: She closed the shelf to Kettlebridge, and I obey. I wish Tavvik would too.

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: elder's son
relations.note: He will be elder after Hollbrenna. He wants Ezra Holt to answer for the cairn, and I understand why.

relations.name: Gaudra
relations.label: neighbour
relations.note: She says the plots will not yield enough. I count the barrels and I am not sure she is wrong.

relations.name: Ezra Holt
relations.label: cairn cutter
relations.note: He cut into the cairn and brought the elder's ban on us all. I do not trust him.

relations.name: Steinar
relations.label: builder
relations.note: He keeps the cairns and the walls; a patient man, and I trust his judgment on stone.

memories.gist: Tavvik and I hunted a stag in the high pastures and carried it back together.
Sunniva and I agreed that the smoked meat would see the shelf through the winter, but Gaudra said the plots would fail.
Hollbrenna forbade trade with Kettlebridge. Tavvik said he would keep carrying meat down the track, and I said nothing.
Grimhild woke afraid of wolves at the edge of the shelf, and I sat with her until she slept.
I counted the meat barrels alone in the store and wondered if they would last until spring.

stances.why: Hollbrenna speaks for the shelf. I may disagree with Tavvik, but I will not defy her openly.
Tavvik is my brother. I will not turn him in, even if I think he is wrong.
The winter is long. I count the barrels because no one else seems to.
I want peace on the shelf. Tavvik's defiance and Gaudra's panic both make that harder.

Sunniva.narrative: I am Sunniva, cook of Highshelf. I keep the common table and the meat store, and I smoke and dry what Harl and Tavvik bring in. The shelf's dignity matters. I will not beg Fernhollow for grain while our store is full. Tavvik's defiance of the elder will bring trouble on us all, and I have told Harl so.
goals: keep the shelf fed through winter
persuade Tavvik to obey the elder
prove the meat store is enough

relations.name: Harl
relations.label: husband
relations.note: He hunts and I cook. He counts the barrels too, though he does not say so.

relations.name: Grimhild
relations.label: daughter
relations.note: She follows me about the common table. I would keep her from every harm.

relations.name: Tavvik
relations.label: brother-in-law
relations.note: He defies the elder and brings trouble on us all. I wish he would stop.

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: elder
relations.note: She closed the shelf to Kettlebridge, and she was right to. We do not need them.

relations.name: Gaudra
relations.label: neighbour
relations.note: She says the plots will fail and wants to trade with Fernhollow. I say the meat store will see us through.

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: elder's son
relations.note: He wants Ezra Holt to answer for the cairn. I want the shelf to stand on its own.

relations.name: Ezra Holt
relations.label: cairn cutter
relations.note: He cut into the cairn and brought the ban on us. I have no love for him.

relations.name: Pipwort Bramblecap
relations.label: trade partner
relations.note: Her pedlars bring fibre and take smoked meat; small folk, but they pay honestly.

relations.name: Steinar
relations.label: builder
relations.note: He keeps the cairns and the walls and does not meddle in the store; I like him for it.

memories.gist: Gaudra said the plots would not yield enough and wanted to trade with Fernhollow. I said the smoked meat would see us through and the shelf should not beg.
Harl and I smoked a whole stag together for the winter store.
Tavvik came back up the track with timber and meat, and I told him the elder had forbidden it. He shrugged.
Grimhild helped me lay the common table for a feast, proud to carry the bowls.
I traded smoked meat with a Fernhollow pedlar and felt the shelf's store grow a little.

stances.why: The common table is my charge. No one goes hungry while I keep the store.
The shelf's dignity matters. We do not beg Fernhollow for grain while our store is full.
Hollbrenna closed the shelf to Kettlebridge. Tavvik should obey her, as we all do.
They cut the cairn. They would sell us short if they could.

Grimhild.narrative: I am Grimhild. I play at the edge of the shelf. The stone blocks are warm in the sun. I am afraid of the wolves that come up the track. Mother cooks, and Father hunts. Uncle Tavvik brings meat.

relations.name: Harl
relations.label: father
relations.note: He is big and warm and smells of the high pastures.

relations.name: Sunniva
relations.label: mother
relations.note: She smells of smoke and bread. I follow her about the common table.

relations.name: Tavvik
relations.label: uncle
relations.note: He brings meat and makes me laugh. He is often away.

relations.name: Vellmund
relations.label: friend
relations.note: He plays among the stone blocks with me.

relations.name: Hollvarr
relations.label: friend
relations.note: He follows his brother about. We play at the edge of the shelf.

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: elder
relations.note: She is very tall and speaks slowly; I am quiet when she comes to the table.

relations.name: Steinar
relations.label: builder
relations.note: He lets me watch the stone chips fly when he dresses a block.

memories.gist: I woke in the night and heard wolves howling up the track. I was afraid and called for Mother.
Uncle Tavvik lifted me up and showed me a fox pelt he had brought back. It was soft.
I played among the stone blocks with Vellmund and Hollvarr until Mother called me to the table.
